values.note: recreation.gov charges $48/night for every electric site in the 2026 season (May 18 - Sep 7) and the 2027 rate season (Apr 5 - Nov 14); tent-only sites $31, group tent area $20. 2025's off-peak rates ($24/$28 electric) are not offered for 2026 or 2027. FIND Outdoors' own page still shows 'Standard Electric $36 - $42, Tent Only Non-Electric $26'. Senior/Access pass half price.

values.note: Reservation required before entering (recreation.gov or 877-444-6777; the campground office cannot take bookings, and nothing is sold at the gatehouse). Weekend stays 2 nights, holiday weekends 3; 14 nights in any 30 at Carters Lake. Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon.

note: USACE Carters Lake (Mobile District; operated by FIND Outdoors), heavily wooded campground on the lake: two boat ramps, small swimming beach, life-jacket loaner station. --Claude
summary: Read recreation.gov (facility, rates, catalog, calendar) and FIND Outdoors' page. Changed fees $36 -> $48 (recreation.gov's 2026 and 2027 electric rate; FIND's page still says $36-42), sites 42 -> 30 RV sites (11 tent-only + group area excluded), season set May 18 - Sep 7 (2026, operator) with the 2027 calendar noted. Confirmed 50A/water, showers, flush toilets, dump. Added reservation-only booking with weekend/holiday minimums. Note cleaned.
flags: Booking caveat: recreation.gov's permitted equipment for 29 of the 30 electric sites is 'Trailer' (most also 'Tent'); only site 035 lists 'RV/Motorhome'. A motorhome search may not offer the other sites - worth checking before booking EKKO.

Fees conflict: recreation.gov (the only booking channel) charges $48/night for electric sites in 2026 and 2027; FIND Outdoors' page says 'Standard Electric $36 - $42'. Recorded the recreation.gov price; if the stored $36 is protected, this is the disagreement.

Website: the second line https://gofindoutdoors.org/sites/woodring/ now redirects to https://gofindoutdoors.org/sites/woodring-developed/ (the operator's page for this campground; /sites/woodring-primitive/ is the separate year-round primitive area). Phone 706-334-2248 is the one FIND posts; recreation.gov also gives (706) 276-6050 for local information.
Pin: 34.61792,-84.64224 sits by group site G1/the entrance; the 30 electric sites' median is 34.61248,-84.64440, about 640 m SSW. Suggest moving the pin there.

Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront', but 8 of the 30 electric sites (027-030, 032-035) are tagged 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' in the recreation.gov catalog, and FIND says the campground 'sits right on beautiful Carters Lake'.
